description: This file implements a SOCKS proxy server and client logic, including connection handling, pattern matching for proxy rules, and event-driven communication for managing SOCKS connections within the Playwright core project.

classes.name: SocksConnection
classes.description: Handles individual SOCKS protocol connection, including authentication, request parsing, and data forwarding.

classes.name: SocksProxy
classes.description: Implements a SOCKS proxy server, managing incoming connections, pattern matching, and direct socket handling.

classes.name: SocksProxyHandler
classes.description: Manages SOCKS client requests, pattern matching for proxy rules, and event emission for connection lifecycle.

methods.name: setPattern
methods.description: Sets the pattern for proxy rule matching.

methods.name: _handleDirect
methods.description: Handles direct socket connection when proxy rules do not match.

methods.name: port
methods.description: Returns the port number the SOCKS server is listening on.

methods.name: listen
methods.description: Starts the SOCKS server listening on a specified port and optional hostname.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the SOCKS server and all active connections.

methods.name: onSocketRequested
methods.description: Handles incoming socket request events, either proxying or direct connection.

methods.name: onSocketData
methods.description: Handles incoming data from sockets and forwards or emits events accordingly.

methods.name: onSocketClosed
methods.description: Handles socket closure events, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: socketConnected
methods.description: Handles socket connection success, updating connection state.

methods.name: socketFailed
methods.description: Handles socket connection failure, emitting error events.

methods.name: sendSocketData
methods.description: Sends data through a socket identified by UID.

methods.name: sendSocketEnd
methods.description: Ends a socket connection identified by UID.

methods.name: sendSocketError
methods.description: Sends an error message for a socket identified by UID.
